SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '1' THEN 1 END) as generalCargoCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '2' THEN 1 END) as hazardousTransportCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '3' THEN 1 END) as smallVehicleCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '4' THEN 1 END) as emergencyVehicleCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.clsstx
deleted = '0'
AND park_code = #{parkCode}
AND countycode = #{countycode}
AND DATE(pass_time) = CURDATE()
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN staff_type = '1' THEN 1 END) as registeredPersonnelCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN staff_type = '2' THEN 1 END) as visitorPersonnelCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.rysstxsj
deleted = '0'
AND park_code = #{parkCode}
AND countycode = #{countycode}
AND DATE(pass_time) = CURDATE()
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT p.park_code,
-- === 1. 模块状态标记 (用于计算接入率) === ( IF(IFNULL(t1.has_kkmj, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t2.has_fkxx, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t3.has_whpcl, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t4.has_qtcl, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t5.has_tcc, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t6.has_clsstx, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t7.has_rysstx, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t8.has_ryssdw, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t9.has_whpclssdw, 0), 1, 0) + IF(IFNULL(t10.has_sbbjsj, 0), 1, 0) ) as moduleCount,
-- === 2. 基础信息数值 === IFNULL(t1.gateCount, 0) as gateCount, IFNULL(t3.hazardousVehicleCount, 0) as hazardousVehicleCount, IFNULL(t4.otherVehicleCount, 0) as otherVehicleCount, IFNULL(t2.visitorCount, 0) as visitorCount,
-- === 3. 通行数据数值 (车辆 - 来自合并后的 t6) === IFNULL(t6.totalVehicleTraffic, 0) as totalVehicleTraffic, IFNULL(t6.generalCargoCount, 0) as generalCargoCount, IFNULL(t6.hazardousTransportCount, 0) as hazardousTransportCount, IFNULL(t6.smallVehicleCount, 0) as smallVehicleCount, IFNULL(t6.emergencyVehicleCount, 0) as emergencyVehicleCount,
-- 人员 - 来自合并后的 t7 IFNULL(t7.registeredPersonnelCount, 0) as registeredPersonnelCount, IFNULL(t7.visitorPersonnelCount, 0) as visitorPersonnelCount,
-- === 4. 报警数据数值 (来自合并后的 t10) === IFNULL(t10.alarm_intrusion, 0) as alarm_intrusion, IFNULL(t10.alarm_speed, 0) as alarm_speed, IFNULL(t10.alarm_help, 0) as alarm_help, IFNULL(t10.alarm_stay, 0) as alarm_stay, IFNULL(t10.alarm_other, 0) as alarm_other
FROM (
SELECT #{code} as park_code
) p
-- 1. 门禁 (kkmj) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_kkmj, COUNT(*) as gateCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.kkmjxx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t1 ON p.park_code = t1.park_code
-- 2. 访客 (fk) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_fkxx, COUNT(*) as visitorCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.fkxx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t2 ON p.park_code = t2.park_code
-- 3. 危化车 (whpcl) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_whpcl, COUNT(*) as hazardousVehicleCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.whpclxx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t3 ON p.park_code = t3.park_code
-- 4. 其他车 (qtcl) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_qtcl, COUNT(*) as otherVehicleCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.qtclxx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t4 ON p.park_code = t4.park_code
-- 5. 危化停车场 (tcc) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_tcc FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.whpyscltccxx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t5 ON p.park_code = t5.park_code
-- 6. 车辆通行 (clsstx) - 合并接入状态 + 各车型计数，原来需要 2 次扫描，现在 1 次 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_clsstx, COUNT(*) AS totalVehicleTraffic, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS generalCargoCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hazardousTransportCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smallVehicleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyVehicleCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.clsstx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} AND pass_time >= #{startTime} AND pass_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY park_code ) t6 ON p.park_code = t6.park_code
-- 7. 人员通行 (rysstxsj) - 合并接入状态 + 人员类型计数，原来需要 2 次扫描，现在 1 次 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_rysstx, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS registeredPersonnelCount, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitorPersonnelCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.rysstxsj WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} AND pass_time >= #{startTime} AND pass_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY park_code ) t7 ON p.park_code = t7.park_code
-- 8. 人员所属单位 (ryssdw) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_ryssdw FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.ryssdw WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t8 ON p.park_code = t8.park_code
-- 9. 危化车所属单位 (whpclssdw) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_whpclssdw FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.whpclssdw WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t9 ON p.park_code = t9.park_code
-- 10. 报警 (sbbjsj) - 合并接入状态 + 各类型报警计数，原来需要 2 次扫描，现在 1 次 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) as has_sbbjsj, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_intrusion, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_speed, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_help, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type NOT IN ('1','2','3','4') OR alarm_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_other FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.sbbjsj WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code ) t10 ON p.park_code = t10.park_code
